title: Rudder response to controller input (step/pulse)
objective: To demonstrate that the simulator directional response from rudder control movements conform to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 10% or ± 1.5º/s yaw rate (r) | ± 1.5º sideslip angle (beta) | ± 1.5 cm or ± 10% pedal displacement
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
